PHRANGE.summary: Returns the stored paths of a path hash between two lexicographic bounds, optionally with their values.
PHRANGE.complexity: O(log(N) + O + M) where N is the number of paths, O the LIMIT offset and M the number of paths returned, plus the size of each returned payload with WITHVALUES.

reply_schema.description: Stored paths in byte lexicographic order, descending with REV, optionally with values.

items.description: The field/value payload when WITHVALUES is used: a map in RESP3 or a flat array in RESP2. Field order is unspecified.

arguments.name: start
arguments.summary: The low bound, or the high bound with REV: [path or (path for an inclusive or exclusive bound, - or + for the ends.

arguments.name: end
arguments.summary: The high bound, or the low bound with REV, in the same syntax as start.

arguments.name: count
arguments.summary: Maximum number of paths to return; a negative count returns every path after the offset.
